```yaml
name: Repository Commands
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      command:
        description: 'Command to execute'
        required: true
        default: '/makerelease'
        type: choice
        options:
          - '/makerelease'
          - '/updatechangelog'
          - '/syncdocs'

jobs:
  commands:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Execute command
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.command }}" = "/makerelease" ]; then
            npm run release
          elif [ "${{ github.event.inputs.command }}" = "/updatechangelog" ]; then
            npm run update-changelog
          elif [ "${{ github.event.inputs.command }}" = "/syncdocs" ]; then
            npm run sync-docs
          else
            echo "Unknown command: ${{ github.event.inputs.command }}"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Commit changes
        if: success()
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: 'Automated command execution: ${{ github.event.inputs.command }}'
          author_name: 'GitHub Actions'
          author_email: 'actions@github.com'
          push: true
```
